##### Project general facts

Aravita Residence is a premium club complex designed for mindful, long-term living in perfect harmony with nature. Located just moments from the ocean, this leasehold sanctuary offers absolute privacy, cutting-edge technology, and a deep connection to its pristine surroundings. Created for refreshment and inspiration, every element of the project, from its floating architecture to its all-in-one concept, has been thoughtfully crafted to deliver effortless luxury.

Residents enjoy a resort-like ecosystem tailored to well-being and connection. The complex features a yoga shala with hammocks, a fully equipped gym, a serene spa complex with sauna and plunge pools, two restaurants, and a smoothie bar. A sunset lounge hosts tranquil tea ceremonies, while the community center combines coworking, meeting rooms, and a lecture hall. Families love the supervised kids club, and twenty-four-seven reception, concierge, security, and storage rooms add seamless convenience.

The interiors embrace the Japandi style, a beautiful fusion of Japanese wabi-sabi philosophy and Scandinavian minimalism, infused with Balinese energy. Expect warm, restrained elegance, natural materials, and zero visual noise. Mirrored facades, floating terraces, and soft lighting create peace and privacy. The kitchen is designed for both function and beauty, complementing a home that feels calm, spacious, and deeply connected to nature.

##### Parking 
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nusa Dua is the quiet, prestigious coastline of Bali, beloved for its world-class hotels, lush green surroundings, and calm rhythm ideal for long-term living. This area offers safe beaches with soft sand and gentle ocean entry, plus a rich infrastructure of international schools, fine restaurants, parks, shops, and shopping centers. Leading global hotel brands have already chosen this location, drawn by its safety, excellent transport access, and timeless appeal.

Sawangan Beach, one of the area’s most pristine stretches, is just minutes away by bike or an easy stroll. A scenic coastal promenade connects residents to multiple beaches, including Geger and Nusa Dua. The nearby Bali Collection shopping center, top-tier restaurants like Koral and Canna, and the prestigious Bali National Golf Club provide endless leisure options, all within a short drive.

The airport and marina are easily reachable, making travel effortless. With its blend of five-star hospitality, green space, and peaceful energy, this part of Badung offers an unmatched lifestyle for those seeking both luxury and tranquility. It’s a place of power where life naturally fills with harmony.
